generated_by: verify_proof.py timing profile + pacing (2026-10-28, THE BAR programme)
headline_unit: NEW DRAWINGS PER SECOND - the owner's unit; a low figure is a failure signature, never an achievement or a style
metric: all consecutive frame pairs, native res, grayscale; a frame pair with diff >= 0.5 on verify_proof.py's own 0-255 scale counts as a change point; spans of near-identical frames are single drawings

below_bar_signatures.note: A flag names a below-bar SIGNATURE (see TIMING-STANDARD.md): interpolation_profile = continuous per-frame change with no held drawings (the v1 signature); uniform_unmodulated_rate = held material at one rate for its whole length with no accent (a plain cycle LOOP under 4 s does not raise it — uniformity is judged at scene/instance scale). The grade of a clip remains the owner's/scorer's call.
